Send a notification using a pre-configured mail template. Requires `template_id` and `channel` (email, sms, or whatsapp).

### Permissions

| Auth Method | Required Permissions |
|---|---|
| [API Key](/developers/getting-started/authentication/#api-key-auth) | Full-access keys: all permissions. Scoped keys: the permission listed for this operation — see [API Key Permissions](/developers/reference/api-key-permissions/) |
| [Basic Auth](/developers/getting-started/authentication/#basic-auth) | `Can send payment notification` (`payment.send_notification`) |
